mapper.select: SELECT FROM marketing_task_export_job WHERE attempt_count < 3 AND (status = 'PENDING' OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until < #{now})) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE marketing_task_export_job SET status = 'FAILED', error_message = #{errorMessage}, lease_until = NULL, claim_token = NULL, finished_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until < #{now} AND attempt_count >= 3
mapper.select: SELECT FROM marketing_task_export_job WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND expires_at <= #{now} AND storage_key IS NOT NULL ORDER BY expires_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE marketing_task_export_job SET status = 'PROCESSING', lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, claim_token = #{claimToken}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, error_message = NULL, updated_at = #{now} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND attempt_count < 3 AND (status = 'PENDING' OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until < #{now}))

UPDATE marketing_task_export_job SET status = 'SUCCESS', storage_key = #{storageKey}, file_name = #{fileName}, content_type = #{contentType}, file_size = #{fileSize}, summary_row_count = #{summaryRowCount}, detail_row_count = #{detailRowCount}, error_message = NULL, lease_until = NULL, claim_token = NULL, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, updated_at = #{finishedAt} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND claim_token = #{claimToken}
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(protocol.reason_code, ''))) = 'CHAT_TERMINATED' OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(protocol.group_status_reason, ''))) = 'CHAT_TERMINATED' THEN '已解散' WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(protocol.reason_code, ''))) IN ('GROUP_BANNED', 'BANNED', 'CHAT_SUSPENDED') OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(protocol.group_status_reason, ''))) = 'CHAT_SUSPENDED' OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(protocol.group_status, ''))) IN ('BANNED', 'GROUP_BANNED') THEN '已封禁' WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(protocol.reason_code, ''))) IN ('KICKED_OUT', 'ACCOUNT_NOT_PARTICIPANT') OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(protocol.group_status_reason, ''))) = 'ACCOUNT_NOT_PARTICIPANT' THEN '账号已被移出' WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(protocol.reason_code, ''))) IN ('NO_PERMISSION', 'ANNOUNCE_ONLY_NON_ADMIN') OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(protocol.group_status_reason, ''))) = 'ANNOUNCE_ONLY_NON_ADMIN' OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(protocol.group_status, ''))) = 'NO_PERMISSION' THEN '无发言权限' WHEN UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(protocol.reason_code, ''))) = 'ACCOUNT_BANNED' THEN '账号封禁' WHEN protocol.projected_status = 1 OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(protocol.group_status, ''))) = 'NORMAL' OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(protocol.group_status_reason, ''))) = 'GROUP_SEND_ALLOWED' THEN '正常' WHEN health.is_banned = 1 THEN '已封禁' WHEN health.health_status = 1 THEN '正常' WHEN health.health_status = 2 THEN '链接失效' WHEN health.health_status = 3 THEN '不可用' ELSE '未确认' END

attempt_source AS ( SELECT a.id AS attempt_id, a.tenant_id, a.marketing_task_id, a.target_id, t.account_id, NULLIF(TRIM(t.account_phone), '') AS account_phone, COALESCE(a.group_link_id, t.group_link_id) AS group_link_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.group_jid), '')) AS group_jid, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.group_name), '')) AS group_name, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(a.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(t.group_jid), ''), CONCAT('link:', COALESCE(a.group_link_id, t.group_link_id)), CONCAT('target:', t.id)) AS group_key, a.status AS raw_status, a.reason_code, a.reason_message, a.group_status, a.group_status_reason, a.round_no, a.attempt_no, a.attempted_at, a.submitted_at, a.result_at, a.created_at AS attempt_created_at, CASE WHEN a.status = 3 THEN COALESCE(a.attempted_at, a.created_at) ELSE COALESCE(a.submitted_at, a.attempted_at, a.created_at) END AS entered_at FROM marketing_task_send_attempt a JOIN marketing_task_target t ON t.id = a.target_id AND t.marketing_task_id = a.marketing_task_id AND t.tenant_id = a.tenant_id WHERE a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (CASE WHEN a.status = 3 THEN COALESCE(a.attempted_at, a.created_at) ELSE COALESCE(a.submitted_at, a.attempted_at, a.created_at) END) <= #{snapshotAt} AND a.marketing_task_id IN
#{taskId}
), projected_attempts AS ( SELECT source.*, CASE WHEN raw_status IN (1, 2) AND result_at IS NOT NULL AND result_at <= #{snapshotAt} THEN raw_status WHEN raw_status = 3 THEN 3 WHEN raw_status IN (1, 2) AND submitted_at <= #{snapshotAt} AND (result_at IS NULL OR result_at > #{snapshotAt}) THEN 0 WHEN raw_status IN (1, 2) AND result_at IS NULL AND submitted_at IS NULL THEN raw_status ELSE 0 END AS projected_status, CASE WHEN result_at IS NOT NULL AND result_at <= #{snapshotAt} THEN result_at WHEN raw_status = 3 THEN COALESCE(attempted_at, attempt_created_at) ELSE entered_at END AS event_at FROM attempt_source source ), attempt_facts AS ( SELECT projected.*, CASE WHEN projected_status = 1 THEN 1 WHEN projected_status = 2 AND ( UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(group_status, ''))) IN ('NORMAL', 'BANNED', 'NO_PERMISSION') OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(reason_code, ''))) IN ( 'ACCOUNT_BANNED', 'KICKED_OUT', 'ACCOUNT_NOT_PARTICIPANT', 'GROUP_BANNED', 'BANNED', 'CHAT_SUSPENDED', 'CHAT_TERMINATED', 'NO_PERMISSION', 'ANNOUNCE_ONLY_NON_ADMIN') OR UPPER(TRIM(COALESCE(group_status_reason, ''))) IN ( 'GROUP_SEND_ALLOWED', 'ACCOUNT_NOT_PARTICIPANT', 'CHAT_SUSPENDED', 'CHAT_TERMINATED', 'ANNOUNCE_ONLY_NON_ADMIN')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS effective_group_status FROM projected_attempts projected ), fixed_target_groups AS ( SELECT t.tenant_id, t.marketing_task_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(p.group_jid), ''), CONCAT('link:', t.group_link_id), CONCAT('target:', t.id)) AS group_key, MIN(t.created_at) AS joined_task_at, MAX(t.group_link_id) AS group_link_id, MAX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(p.group_jid), ''))) AS group_jid, MAX(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(t.group_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(g.group_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(p.wa_subject), ''))) AS group_name, MAX(NULLIF(TRIM(e.group_invite_url), '')) AS execution_group_invite_url, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT( NULLIF(TRIM(t.group_link_url), '') ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.id DESC SEPARATOR '
'), '
', 1) AS target_group_link_url, CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT( t.account_id ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.id DESC SEPARATOR '
'), '
', 1) AS UNSIGNED) AS sender_account_id, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT( t.account_phone ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.id DESC SEPARATOR '
'), '
', 1) AS sender_phone FROM marketing_task_target t LEFT JOIN group_link g ON g.id = t.group_link_id AND g.tenant_id = t.tenant_id LEFT JOIN group_link_preview p ON p.group_link_id = t.group_link_id AND p.tenant_id = t.tenant_id LEFT JOIN group_pull_marketing_execution e ON e.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND e.group_jid = COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(t.group_jid), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(p.group_jid), '')) WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND COALESCE(t.target_scope, 1) = 1 AND t.created_at <= #{snapshotAt} AND t.marketing_task_id IN
#{taskId}
GROUP BY t.tenant_id, t.marketing_task_id, group_key ), attempt_dimensions AS ( SELECT tenant_id, marketing_task_id, group_key, MIN(attempt_created_at) AS joined_task_at, SUM(CASE WHEN projected_status IN (0, 1, 2) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS planned_count, SUM(CASE WHEN projected_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN projected_status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN projected_status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_count, MIN(CASE WHEN projected_status <> 3 AND attempted_at <= #{snapshotAt} THEN attempted_at END) AS first_sent_at, MAX(CASE WHEN projected_status <> 3 AND attempted_at <= #{snapshotAt} THEN attempted_at END) AS last_sent_at FROM attempt_facts GROUP BY tenant_id, marketing_task_id, group_key ), group_dimensions AS ( SELECT tenant_id, marketing_task_id, group_key FROM fixed_target_groups UNION SELECT tenant_id, marketing_task_id, group_key FROM attempt_dimensions ), selected_group_jids AS ( SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id, group_jid FROM fixed_target_groups WHERE group_jid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(group_jid) <> '' UNION SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id, group_jid FROM attempt_source WHERE group_jid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(group_jid) <> '' ), latest_any AS ( SELECT ranked.* FROM ( SELECT af.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY tenant_id, marketing_task_id, group_key ORDER BY round_no DESC, attempt_no DESC, attempt_id DESC) AS row_rank FROM attempt_facts af ) ranked WHERE ranked.row_rank = 1 ), latest_protocol AS ( SELECT ranked.* FROM ( SELECT af.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY tenant_id, marketing_task_id, group_key ORDER BY effective_group_status DESC, round_no DESC, attempt_no DESC, attempt_id DESC) AS protocol_rank FROM attempt_facts af WHERE projected_status IN (1, 2) ) ranked WHERE ranked.protocol_rank = 1 ), latest_ended AS ( SELECT ranked.* FROM ( SELECT af.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY tenant_id, marketing_task_id, group_key ORDER BY round_no DESC, attempt_no DESC, attempt_id DESC) AS ended_rank FROM attempt_facts af WHERE projected_status IN (1, 2, 3) ) ranked WHERE ranked.ended_rank = 1 ), latest_failure_round AS ( SELECT tenant_id, marketing_task_id, group_key, MAX(round_no) AS round_no FROM attempt_facts WHERE projected_status = 2 GROUP BY tenant_id, marketing_task_id, group_key ), failure_reasons AS ( SELECT af.tenant_id, af.marketing_task_id, af.group_key, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(af.reason_message), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(af.reason_code), ''), '未知原因') ORDER BY af.attempt_id ASC SEPARATOR '；') AS failure_reasons FROM attempt_facts af JOIN latest_failure_round latest ON latest.tenant_id = af.tenant_id AND latest.marketing_task_id = af.marketing_task_id AND latest.group_key = af.group_key AND latest.round_no = af.round_no WHERE af.projected_status = 2 GROUP BY af.tenant_id, af.marketing_task_id, af.group_key ), joined_counts AS ( SELECT selected.tenant_id, jtr.group_jid, COUNT(DISTINCT NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE( COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(joined_account.ws_phone), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(jtr.account), '')), '[^0-9]', ''), '')) AS joined_count FROM selected_group_jids selected JOIN join_task_result jtr ON jtr.tenant_id = selected.tenant_id AND jtr.group_jid = selected.group_jid LEFT JOIN account joined_account ON joined_account.id = jtr.account_id AND joined_account.tenant_id = jtr.tenant_id WHERE jtr.status = 'SUCCESS' AND COALESCE(jtr.joined_at, jtr.updated_at, jtr.created_at) <= #{snapshotAt} GROUP BY selected.tenant_id, jtr.group_jid ), group_rows AS ( SELECT COALESCE(fixed.joined_task_at, attempts.joined_task_at) AS joinedTaskAt, mt.id AS taskId, mt.task_name AS taskName, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(latest.group_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(fixed.group_name), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(preview.wa_subject), ''), '未命名群组') AS groupName, COALESCE(latest.group_jid, fixed.group_jid) AS groupJid, COALESCE( CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fixed.execution_group_invite_url)) LIKE 'https://chat.whatsapp.com/%' THEN CONCAT('https://chat.whatsapp.com/', NULLIF(SUBSTRING_INDEX( SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING( TRIM(fixed.execution_group_invite_url), CHAR_LENGTH('https://chat.whatsapp.com/') + 1), '?', 1), '#', 1), '/', 1), '')) END, CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(fixed.target_group_link_url)) LIKE 'https://chat.whatsapp.com/%' THEN CONCAT('https://chat.whatsapp.com/', NULLIF(SUBSTRING_INDEX( SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING( TRIM(fixed.target_group_link_url), CHAR_LENGTH('https://chat.whatsapp.com/') + 1), '?', 1), '#', 1), '/', 1), '')) END, CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(preview.invite_code, '')) REGEXP '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$' THEN CONCAT('https://chat.whatsapp.com/', TRIM(preview.invite_code)) END, CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(group_link.link_url)) LIKE 'https://chat.whatsapp.com/%' THEN CONCAT('https://chat.whatsapp.com/', NULLIF(SUBSTRING_INDEX( SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING( TRIM(group_link.link_url), CHAR_LENGTH('https://chat.whatsapp.com/') + 1), '?', 1), '#', 1), '/', 1), '')) END) AS groupLink, d.group_key AS groupKey, AS groupStatus, CASE WHEN preview.announce_only = 1 AND membership.is_admin = 1 THEN '仅管理员可发言（发送账号可发言）' WHEN preview.announce_only = 1 THEN '无发言权限' WHEN preview.announce_only = 0 THEN '所有成员可发言' ELSE '未确认' END AS speechPermission, COALESCE(health.current_count, preview.member_size) AS groupMemberCount, COALESCE(joined.joined_count, 0) AS joinedPhoneCount, COALESCE(attempts.planned_count, 0) AS plannedCount, COALESCE(attempts.success_count, 0) AS successCount, COALESCE(attempts.failed_count, 0) AS failedCount, COALESCE(attempts.unknown_count, 0) AS unknownCount, COALESCE(latest.account_phone, fixed.sender_phone) AS senderPhone, COALESCE(latest.account_id, fixed.sender_account_id) AS observerAccountId, CASE WHEN account_state.mute_status = 1 THEN '禁言6小时' WHEN account_state.mute_status = 2 THEN '禁言24小时' WHEN account_state.account_state = 1 THEN '新增' WHEN account_state.account_state = 2 THEN '正常' WHEN account_state.account_state = 3 THEN '封禁' WHEN account_state.account_state = 4 THEN '导出' WHEN account_state.account_state = 5 THEN '解绑' WHEN account_state.account_state = 6 THEN '被抢登' WHEN account_state.account_state = 7 THEN '抢登中' WHEN account_state.account_state = 8 THEN '账号受限' ELSE '—' END AS accountStatus, attempts.first_sent_at AS firstSentAt, attempts.last_sent_at AS lastSentAt, CASE WHEN COALESCE(attempts.planned_count, 0) = 0 THEN '未发送' WHEN COALESCE(attempts.unknown_count, 0) > 0 AND mt.status = 2 THEN '发送中' WHEN COALESCE(attempts.success_count, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(attempts.failed_count, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(attempts.unknown_count, 0) = 0 THEN '成功' WHEN COALESCE(attempts.success_count, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(attempts.failed_count, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(attempts.unknown_count, 0) = 0 THEN '失败' WHEN COALESCE(attempts.success_count, 0) > 0 THEN '部分成功' WHEN COALESCE(attempts.unknown_count, 0) > 0 THEN '结果未知' ELSE '未发送' END AS sendStatus, COALESCE(failures.failure_reasons, CASE WHEN ended.projected_status = 3 THEN COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(ended.reason_message), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(ended.reason_code), ''), '本轮已跳过') END) AS failureReason, group_link.remark AS remark FROM group_dimensions d JOIN marketing_task mt ON mt.id = d.marketing_task_id AND mt.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND mt.business_type = 1 AND mt.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN fixed_target_groups fixed ON fixed.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND fixed.marketing_task_id = d.marketing_task_id AND fixed.group_key = d.group_key LEFT JOIN attempt_dimensions attempts ON attempts.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND attempts.marketing_task_id = d.marketing_task_id AND attempts.group_key = d.group_key LEFT JOIN latest_any latest ON latest.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND latest.marketing_task_id = d.marketing_task_id AND latest.group_key = d.group_key LEFT JOIN latest_protocol protocol ON protocol.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND protocol.marketing_task_id = d.marketing_task_id AND protocol.group_key = d.group_key LEFT JOIN latest_ended ended ON ended.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND ended.marketing_task_id = d.marketing_task_id AND ended.group_key = d.group_key LEFT JOIN failure_reasons failures ON failures.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND failures.marketing_task_id = d.marketing_task_id AND failures.group_key = d.group_key LEFT JOIN group_link_preview preview ON preview.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND preview.group_link_id = COALESCE(latest.group_link_id, fixed.group_link_id) LEFT JOIN group_link_health health ON health.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND health.group_link_id = COALESCE(latest.group_link_id, fixed.group_link_id) LEFT JOIN group_link ON group_link.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND group_link.id = COALESCE(latest.group_link_id, fixed.group_link_id) LEFT JOIN joined_counts joined ON joined.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND joined.group_jid = COALESCE(latest.group_jid, fixed.group_jid) LEFT JOIN account_group_membership membership ON membership.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND membership.account_id = COALESCE(latest.account_id, fixed.sender_account_id) AND membership.group_jid = COALESCE(latest.group_jid, fixed.group_jid) AND membership.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN account_state account_state ON account_state.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND account_state.account_id = COALESCE(latest.account_id, fixed.sender_account_id) )
mapper.select: WITH SELECT joinedTaskAt, taskId, taskName, groupName, groupJid, groupLink, groupStatus, speechPermission, groupMemberCount, joinedPhoneCount, plannedCount, successCount, failedCount, unknownCount, senderPhone, accountStatus, firstSentAt, lastSentAt, sendStatus, failureReason, remark FROM group_rows ORDER BY taskId ASC, groupKey ASC
mapper.sql: observer_source AS ( SELECT group_data.taskId, group_data.groupJid, attempts.account_id AS accountId, CASE WHEN attempts.projected_status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS successful, attempts.event_at AS eventAt, attempts.attempt_id AS sourceId FROM group_rows group_data JOIN attempt_facts attempts ON attempts.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND attempts.marketing_task_id = group_data.taskId AND attempts.group_jid = group_data.groupJid WHERE group_data.groupJid IS NOT NULL AND attempts.account_id IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT group_data.taskId, group_data.groupJid, group_data.observerAccountId AS accountId, 0 AS successful, COALESCE(group_data.lastSentAt, group_data.joinedTaskAt, 0) AS eventAt, 0 AS sourceId FROM group_rows group_data WHERE group_data.groupJid IS NOT NULL AND group_data.observerAccountId IS NOT NULL ), observer_eligible AS ( SELECT source.* FROM observer_source source JOIN account observer_account ON observer_account.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND observer_account.id = source.accountId AND observer_account.deleted_at IS NULL AND observer_account.protocol_account_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(observer_account.protocol_account_id) <> '' AND observer_account.ws_phone IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(observer_account.ws_phone) <> '' JOIN account_state observer_state ON observer_state.tenant_id = observer_account.tenant_id AND observer_state.account_id = observer_account.id AND observer_state.account_state = 2 AND observer_state.login_state = 1 JOIN account_group_membership observer_membership ON observer_membership.tenant_id = observer_account.tenant_id AND observer_membership.account_id = observer_account.id AND observer_membership.group_jid = source.groupJid AND observer_membership.deleted_at IS NULL AND observer_membership.membership_status = 1 ), observer_account_ranked AS ( SELECT source.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY taskId, groupJid, accountId ORDER BY successful DESC, eventAt DESC, sourceId DESC) AS accountRank FROM observer_eligible source ), observer_ranked AS ( SELECT distinct_account.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY taskId, groupJid ORDER BY successful DESC, eventAt DESC, sourceId DESC, accountId ASC) AS candidateRank FROM observer_account_ranked distinct_account WHERE accountRank = 1 )

WITH ,
SELECT group_data.joinedTaskAt, group_data.taskId, group_data.taskName, group_data.groupName, group_data.groupJid, group_data.groupLink, group_data.groupStatus, group_data.speechPermission, group_data.groupMemberCount, group_data.joinedPhoneCount, group_data.plannedCount, group_data.successCount, group_data.failedCount, group_data.unknownCount, group_data.senderPhone, group_data.accountStatus, group_data.firstSentAt, group_data.lastSentAt, group_data.sendStatus, group_data.failureReason, group_data.remark, observer.accountId AS observerAccountId, observer.candidateRank AS observerCandidateRank FROM group_rows group_data LEFT JOIN observer_ranked observer ON observer.taskId = group_data.taskId AND observer.groupJid = group_data.groupJid AND observer.candidateRank <= 2 ORDER BY group_data.taskId ASC, group_data.groupKey ASC, observer.candidateRank ASC

WITH SELECT group_data.taskId, group_data.taskName, group_data.groupName, group_data.groupLink, group_data.groupStatus, group_data.groupMemberCount, member_account.ws_phone AS memberPhone, CASE WHEN membership.is_admin = 1 THEN '管理员' WHEN membership.is_admin = 0 THEN '群成员' ELSE '未知' END AS role, NULL AS countryName, CASE WHEN membership.membership_status = 1 THEN '是' WHEN membership.membership_status IN (3, 4, 5) THEN '否' ELSE '未知' END AS inGroup, CASE WHEN membership.last_exited_at <= #{snapshotAt} AND membership.last_exit_type = 3 THEN '被移出群组' WHEN membership.last_exited_at <= #{snapshotAt} AND membership.last_exit_type = 4 THEN '主动退群' WHEN membership.last_exited_at <= #{snapshotAt} AND membership.last_exit_type = 5 THEN '退出原因未识别' ELSE '' END AS exitType, CASE WHEN membership.joined_at <= #{snapshotAt} THEN membership.joined_at END AS joinedAt, CASE WHEN membership.last_exited_at <= #{snapshotAt} THEN membership.last_exited_at END AS exitedAt, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM join_task_result member_join WHERE member_join.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND member_join.group_jid = group_data.groupJid AND member_join.account_id = membership.account_id AND member_join.status = 'SUCCESS' AND COALESCE(member_join.joined_at, member_join.updated_at, member_join.created_at) BETWEEN COALESCE(group_data.joinedTaskAt, 0) AND #{snapshotAt} ) THEN '本任务成功进群' ELSE '原群成员' END AS taskJoinStatus FROM group_rows group_data JOIN account_group_membership membership ON membership.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership.group_jid = group_data.groupJid AND membership.deleted_at IS NULL AND membership.created_at <= #{snapshotAt} JOIN account member_account ON member_account.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND member_account.id = membership.account_id AND member_account.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE group_data.groupJid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(group_data.groupJid) <> '' ORDER BY group_data.taskId ASC, group_data.groupKey ASC, membership.account_id ASC
